# Endpoint HTTP coverage (generated by EndpointMatrixTests)

Every routed controller endpoint (301 method+route pairs) is called over real HTTP against the API
hosted in-process over seeded SQLite, as anonymous and as Admin / Accountant / User / Cashier.
Cell = expectation:status. `deny` must be 401 (anonymous) or 403 (role outside [Authorize]); `ok` must never be 401 or 5xx.
Limits: allowed roles are called with an empty body or placeholder ids, so most return 400/404/409 (validation or not-found),
which proves routing, auth and input rejection, NOT business success. Success paths are covered by the service tests and
ApiSmokeTests. Run: `ENDPOINT_MATRIX_OUT=docs/endpoint-coverage.md dotnet test --filter EndpointMatrixTests` (overwrites this table).
